_description: Reference data digitized from Gavel OSDI 2020 paper Figures 9a, 10a, 11a. Values are approximate readings from the published plots. Each figure shows Average JCT (hours) vs Input Job Rate (jobs/hr).
_source: Narayanan et al., 'Heterogeneity-Aware Cluster Scheduling Policies for Deep Learning Workloads', OSDI 2020

fig9._description: Figure 9a: Single-GPU jobs, LAS (Max-Min Fairness) policy. Continuous-single trace.

fig10._description: Figure 10a: Multi-GPU jobs (70% 1-worker, 25% 2-4 workers, 5% 8 workers), LAS (Max-Min Fairness) policy. Continuous-multiple trace.

fig11._description: Figure 11a: Multi-GPU jobs, Finish-Time Fairness (FTF) policy. Continuous-multiple trace.

_validation_checks.general_pattern: All curves show hockey-stick behavior as cluster saturates; Gavel shifts the saturation point to the right
